sloka: स तं निपतितं भूमौ शरण्यः शरणागतम् ।वधार्हमपि काकुत्स्थः कृपया पर्यपालयत् ।। ५.३८.३४।।।।
transliteration: sa taṁ nipatitaṁ bhūmau śaraṇyaḥ śaraṇāgatam ।vadhārhamapi kākutsthaḥ kṛpayā paryapālayat ।। 5.38.34।।।।

translations.english: 'Seeing the crow fallen on the ground, O Kakutstha, you who are a saviour of those who seek refuge saved him out of compassion, even though he deserved to be killed.
